## @umber-style/cache@0.2.0

A release for the new range of its dependency on the core, with nothing changed in this package.
([#52](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/issues/52))

### Changed

- Through `@umber-style/core` 0.2.0, a cache works where the program loads two copies of the core: a name that `keyframes()` of either returned is written, and `findCache` of either finds it. A cache of this package is now taken as it is by `createInstance({ cache })` of `@umber-style/css/create-instance`.
  [docs](https://github.com/soroush-tech/umber-style/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md#two-copies-in-one-program)

### Packaging

- Depends on `@umber-style/core` `^0.2.0` (it was the exact `0.1.0`): it is declared `workspace:^`. A patch of the core now reaches this package without a release of its own, and an app keeps one copy.
- MINOR, with the core, which has new public API.
